biography: Matti entered the esteemed Hector Trophée with a focused, albeit succinct, competitive tenure, contributing to the tournament's rich history through his presence on the greens. His engagement, though brief, underscored a commitment to test his abilities within the event's challenging framework.

Across his two distinct appearances in this prestigious competition, Matti diligently contended in both the collaborative pair format and the individual challenges. Despite his earnest efforts, neither the esteemed Hector Trophée for the winning pair nor the individual Victor Trophy ultimately materialized, highlighting the formidable standard required for triumph in this annual event.

Presently, Matti is regarded as having concluded his active competitive chapter within Hector events. Consequently, he will not be among the distinguished competitors vying for accolades at the forthcoming Hector Trophée 2026, his journey remaining a concise yet notable entry in the tournament's enduring chronicles.
